newsitem.title: RUSSIA: De Beers-Russia deal signing largely formality - ARS.
newsitem.headline: De Beers-Russia deal signing largely formality - ARS.

text.p: Russia's monopoly diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) said on Thursday that the signing of a stalled gem trade deal with De Beers was now largely a formality.

"The thing now is to get the proposed agreement approved by the Russian government, but after the decisions taken together this is, to a significant degree, already a formality," ARS said in a statement.
Last week De Beers held talks with ARS and Russian government officials in Moscow, and on Monday De Beers said that talks would continue at working party level this week.
In its statement ARS said that as a result of last week's meetings, "a final version of the trade deal has been produced".
